release.title: Device-Only Document Review, Comparison, and Exact Source-Line Provenance
release.artifactSha256Location: Smarter_Justice_v1.7.12_Exact_Artifact_Test_Record.json (external companion generated after final ZIP testing)

deployment.statement: Code completion and exact-artifact testing do not change production status.

changes.problem: Public users could describe a notice and prepare form information but lacked a dedicated free way to organize exact document text without opening confidential storage or sending the content to Smarter Justice.
changes.implementation: Added a browser-tab-only text review workspace for supported local text files and pasted text. It reports one-based source lines, exact excerpts, document metrics, likely headings, stated dates, action language, amounts, reference identifiers, contact information, and instruction-like text.
changes.preserved: No document content is transmitted, saved, placed in analytics, sent to AI, shared with a professional, or represented as legal or professional advice. PDFs, scans, images, OCR, persistent storage, and confidential uploads remain unavailable.

changes.problem: The general platform had no public, privacy-preserving way to compare two text versions with exact source references.
changes.implementation: Added neutral line-oriented comparison showing added, removed, changed, and optionally unchanged lines with Version A and Version B line numbers, plus a complete local text download.
changes.preserved: The tool does not characterize a change as favorable, unfavorable, legal, illegal, valid, enforceable, or complete, and it does not replace review of formatting, signatures, exhibits, attachments, tables, or the original documents.

changes.problem: A new capability would be misleading or difficult to find without consistent public navigation, privacy language, limits, responsive behavior, and shared-capability records.
changes.implementation: Added homepage, notice-page, How It Works, privacy, footer, and sitemap integration; accessible error, focus, counter, clear, and download states; responsive layouts; and two proven capability-registry records for later evidence-based portal reuse.
changes.preserved: No shared capability is forced into another portal. Each portal must separately evaluate specialty fit, jurisdiction, safety, privacy, and regression requirements.

tests.path: fresh extraction, clean install/audit, npm test, syntax/JSON, public links, ZIP safety, source equality, local health and fail-closed boundaries
